headline: ORDER
COFFEE
IN ENGLISH
title: Learn English While You Sleep | Ordering Coffee | A2 Practice
description: Learn English While You Sleep | Ordering Coffee. Practice ordering coffee with Alex and Emma. Listen, repeat and answer aloud. Original A2 English lesson with two voices and on-screen subtitles.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Let's practice ordering coffee. Listen to Emma and Alex.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Hi! What can I get for you today?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Hi! I'd like a coffee, please.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Of course. Would you like it hot or iced?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Hot, please. And could I have oat milk?

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Absolutely! What size would you like?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: A medium, please. How much is that?

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Now, repeat after Alex. Say each phrase out loud.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Your turn! I'll ask, and you answer.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: What can I get for you today?

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Great! Practice again with your favorite drink.
